description: Fontanini di Acqua potabile del Comune di Matera is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Matera. File con tutti i fontanini serviti dall'Acquedotto Lucano spa, compresi quelli chiusi, di proprietà del Comune di Matera (quindi sono esclusi quelli di proprietà del AQL) MAPPA. Coverage: Comune di Matera. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Matera. Its tags are acqua, acquedotto, acquedotto-lucano, fontanini. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
